title: July Revolution
summary: In Paris on 27, 28 and 29 July 1830, the Trois Glorieuses, residents raised barricades against Charles X after his ordinances restricting the press. The uprising ended the Bourbon monarchy and brought Louis-Philippe, Duke of Orléans, to the throne as head of a constitutional monarchy, the July Monarchy.

uncertainty.note: Fighting dated 27-29 July 1830 by the CMN page; Brown gives 27 July as first day of violence and 29 July as the final day.

where.modern_name: Paris, France (pin at Place de la Bastille, proxy for the city)

importance.justification: Brought down the restored Bourbon monarchy in France and installed the July Monarchy.
